text:
Lizzy: quick design check — suppression modal feels... off when you tab through notification channels. focus jumps out of the modal sometimes :confused: Omar: can you repro steps? mac + chrome? or windows? Lizzy: mac chrome. steps: open alert -> Edit suppression -> tab through to add channel -> after selecting a channel, focus lands behind the modal (page body). Patrick: that sounds like a focus-trap missing on channel list. we should trap keyboard focus inside modal and return to triggering element on close. Sam: also noticed channel chips have 2.5:1 contrast on selected state when in compact list. fails a11y contrast for text. Maya: re: chips — is compact mode required in modal? maybe we can use full pills in modal and reserve compact for the matrix view. that would help spacing + contrast. Lizzy: good call. compact pills were an attempt to reduce vertical height but modal is already constrained. switching to full pills in modal is a quick win. a11y-bot: Automated scan result: color-contrast failure on `.chip--selected` in modal (AA large text fail). Suggest Alternatives: increase fill opacity or add border + bold text. Omar: microcopy thing — the column header "Channels" is overloaded. when suppressed we also show "route" and "preview" icons. can we change header to "Notification channels & routes"? Patrick: that's a mouthful. what about adding a tiny help tooltip instead: "Channels — choose destinations for this suppression" and keep header short. Lizzy: tooltip is nicer. also needs keyboard-accessible tooltip (focusable icon). Sam: small keyboard nit: after selecting a channel from list, hitting Enter should confirm selection but currently it closes modal. expected: Enter selects focus item; Esc closes. Maya: UX rule: avoid Enter triggering close unless it's explicitly a submit button. fix in handler. Lizzy: doc-level copy: current label "Start time" / "End time" -> folks misread timezone. propose "Start time (TZ: UTC)" or show timezone selector. Omar: prefer showing user-local timezone by default and a small link "Change timezone". avoid inline parentheses in label if possible. Patrick: accessibility note: suppression summary in the drawer should have `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers get updates when schedule changes. Sam: here's a snippet for the live region we can drop in: ```html
Suppression scheduled: Mon 9am — Tue 9am (UTC)
``` Lizzy: thanks. also we should add role="dialog" and ensure `aria-modal=true` on modal container. a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure focus is set to first focusable control in modal on open. failure rates: observed in 7% of tests. Maya: small copy suggestion for preview CTA: current "Preview channels" -> change to "Preview notifications" to clarify that this shows what will be sent, not channel routing. Omar: +1. also let's show a compact inline preview pill list (max 3) with a "+N more" link that opens full preview. keeps modal height under control. Patrick: implementation detail: for keyboard nav, `tabindex="0"` only on interactive items, avoid adding to non-interactive wrappers. that's been causing odd tab stops. Lizzy: summary action items: 1) swap compact -> full pills in modal 2) implement focus-trap + set focus on open 3) fix Enter behavior vs submit 4) address chip contrast 5) add aria-live summary 6) change preview copy + add inline pill preview Sam: happy to take 2 & 3. will open PR with tests. Maya: I'll update the mock and microcopy doc today and add a11y checklist. Omar: I'll iterate on header tooltip and timezone UX. Lizzy: thanks all — leaving this open for follow-ups. will ping when mocks are uploaded :thumbsup:
